title: Sanctions for violations.
bodyText: The vendor or its employee or authorized representative shall be subject to sanctions pursuant to this chapter for the violation of any provision of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§431:31-105]  Sanctions for violations.  The vendor or its employee or authorized representative shall be subject to sanctions pursuant to this chapter for the violation of any provision of this chapter. [L 2012, c 321, pt of §1]
